steps: 1. Read backend/app/api/v1/schemas.py to understand existing MarketOutcomeResponse and MarketAnalysisResponse structures.

2. EXTEND MarketOutcomeResponse in backend/app/api/v1/schemas.py with optional Phase 5 fields: real_odds: Optional[float] = Field(None, description='Real bookmaker odds if available'), implied_probability: Optional[float] = Field(None, description='Implied probability from real odds'), market_edge: Optional[float] = Field(None, description='Market edge (model_prob - implied_prob)'), bookmaker: Optional[str] = Field(None, description='Bookmaker source'), odds_timestamp: Optional[datetime] = Field(None, description='When odds were recorded'). All fields optional for backward compatibility.
3. Verify MarketAnalysisResponse already has bookmaker_overround field. If missing, add: bookmaker_overround: Optional[float] = Field(None, description='Bookmaker margin/overround').

4. Read backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/predictions.py (or wherever prediction endpoints are defined) to verify MarketOutcomeResponse is properly mapped from MarketOutcome domain objects. If mapping exists, extend it to include Phase 5 fields when available.

5. Read frontend/src/api/types.ts. EXTEND MarketOutcomeResponse interface with optional Phase 5 fields: real_odds?: number | null, implied_probability?: number | null, market_edge?: number | null, bookmaker?: string | null, odds_timestamp?: string | null.

6. Read frontend/src/components/predictions/MensionePickCard.tsx to understand current structure and props. The component is ~700 lines, structured with tabs (general, first-half, full-match). DO NOT redesign the card.

7. EXTEND MensionePickCardProps interface in frontend/src/components/predictions/MensionePickCard.tsx with optional Phase 5 props at the end: marketEdge?: number | null, impliedProbability?: number | null, bookmakerSource?: string | null, valueClassification?: string | null.

8. In frontend/src/components/predictions/MensionePickCard.tsx, find the technical details section (likely in 'general' tab). ADD conditional rendering ONLY when Phase 5 props are available: display market edge as percentage if marketEdge !== null, display implied probability as percentage if impliedProbability !== null, display bookmaker source if bookmakerSource !== null, display value classification badge if valueClassification !== null. Use existing card styling patterns. Maximum 4-5 lines of new UI.
9. Run frontend type-check: cd c:\FootballIntelligence\frontend; npm run type-check. Verify no TypeScript errors.
10. Run backend tests: cd c:\FootballIntelligence\backend; python -m pytest tests/ -v. Verify all tests still pass (886+ passing, 15 skipped).
